name: Khazarad, Garden Walk
desc1: This broad, flagstone-lined curves around the centre of the dwarven
desc2: city. All along the inner edge of this street are beautifully-carved
desc3: statues of armoured dwarves, with noble expressions on their faces.
desc4: The craftsmanship is such that they would be indistinguishable from a
desc5: real dwarf if they were not stone. The sides of buildings stand to the
desc6: south and west, while Garden Walk curves around to the north and east.
